title: Probabilistic changelings: a simple observer may not match its own first-person chances

statements.text: When an observer is young or simple compared with the description of the world it appears in, the chances governing it in another's world can differ greatly from its own first-person chances. The 2020 paper calls it a probabilistic zombie, the 2024 paper a probabilistic changeling, and it is not meant as an unconscious being.
